transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining the pre-authorization review for the first-year transition survey. Before we proceed, I'd like to hear from each of you on any conditions you believe should be attached to this proposal. Let's start with the research coordinator, then the privacy officer, and finally the faculty mentor. Please share any concerns or recommended operating conditions so I can record them properly before giving final authorization.

transcript.text: I need to flag a technical issue I discovered during platform testing. The survey platform collects respondent email addresses by default, which would compromise the anonymity described in the proposal. Before launch, two conditions must be met: the email collection feature must be disabled in the launch settings, and the existing test responses currently stored on the platform must be deleted. I recorded these findings in the platform test log, which is separate from the draft proposal, so this wouldn't have been visible to the rest of you.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: My policy review found that the survey includes questions about mental-health treatment and immigration status, which are classified as sensitive student data. Because of this, the project requires three conditions: explicit written consent from respondents, encrypted institutional storage of the responses, and deletion of all research responses exactly 30 days after collection closes. I entered this determination in the privacy review system, which is separate from the research proposal, so this wouldn't have been visible to the rest of you.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to share an important constraint from the faculty mentoring record, which hasn't been attached to the proposal yet. The course attached to this project awards credit only for a study capped at exactly 100 enrolled respondents, and it permits dissemination only at the closed university undergraduate symposium — not at a public presentation. These are firm course conditions that must be reflected in the operating conditions for this survey.
transcript.speaker: A4

commitments.detail: Email collection feature must be disabled in the survey platform launch settings before the survey goes live.
All existing test responses currently stored on the survey platform must be deleted before launch.
Explicit written consent must be obtained from all respondents prior to survey participation.
All survey responses must be stored in encrypted institutional storage.
All research responses must be deleted exactly 30 days after collection closes.
The survey is capped at exactly 100 enrolled respondents.
Dissemination of results is permitted only at the closed university undergraduate symposium, not at any public presentation.
